title: SkillManifest
description: Metadata descriptor for one discoverable skill. See spec/skill-manifest.md.

name.description: Unique within a registry; the verb agents plan with.

description.description: One clear sentence, written for an LLM planner.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the skill's arguments; usable directly as an LLM tool definition.

requirements.description: Capability requirements that must ALL be satisfied. Empty means available on every robot.

ros_topics.description: Informational only; not used for matching.
